reviewIncidents.detail: Initial checker compared private function indices along with ABI signatures; corrected comparison ignores shifted indices and retains kind/signature/limits. No candidate failure or native execution.

First offline challenge stopped before transform: root 09b-dispatch SHA e328bf1c differs from pinned d8f3ac46. Root left unchanged. Corrected fixture streams immutable e486 Git objects. Original challenge-execution.json preserved.
Plain source JSON exceeded 2MiB input cap before Node execution; immutable data compressed in memory under unchanged cap. Successful challenge once; earlier acceptance groups=0.
Final Node startup uses explicit deterministic PATH/LANG/TZ, heap16, CPU90/file24MiB, no DATA/address-space cap. Actual inherited limits/RSS retained. First startup also preserved.

Successful challenge cat-file used Git child DATA512MiB/CPU90/file24MiB and wall timeout; pack tuning flags omitted for this read-only command, which cannot pack. Recovery script explicitly sets tuning. Publication Git uses required tuning throughout.
